transcript.content: Hello, I'm Dr. Smith. It's nice to meet you. Could you tell me what brings you in to see me today?

Well... I guess my eating has just gotten a bit... turned around lately. Some days I just forget to have lunch completely. And then other times, I'll just stand at the kitchen counter eating crackers and sweets... even though none of it really tastes right.
When you think about your current eating habits, do you feel an intense fear of gaining weight?
No... I don't think so. I'm not really... worried about my weight. It's just what I said before, I suppose.
Beyond your eating habits, have you been feeling down, sad, or lacking interest in things you usually enjoy lately?

I suppose... maybe a little. It's mostly just in the mornings. I'll wake up and... well, there's just this heavy, low feeling. It just seems like the color has already gone out of the day before I even manage to get dressed. But... that's about it, really.
How long have you been feeling this way in the mornings?
I'm not entirely sure of the exact day... but I suppose that low, colorless stretch has been with me for... maybe about a year and two months now. Give or take.
During these past fourteen months, have you felt consistently tired or lacked the energy to get through your daily tasks?
No... not really. I just... do what needs doing around the house. I wouldn't say I'm unusually tired.
During these past fourteen months, have there been any periods where you felt like your usual, happy self for two months or more?

I don't... no, not for two whole months. If I really look back at it... I suppose the sadness, and just not caring for things, has taken up most of this whole time... ever since my sister got sick. Even when... well, even when those worries about the records were a bit quieter... it's mostly just been that same low feeling.
Do you often find yourself feeling inadequate or like you are not as good as others?
No, I... I wouldn't say that. I just... I am who I am. I don't really think about comparing myself to other people.
During these past fourteen months, have you found it difficult to concentrate or make decisions?

I suppose... maybe a little. Sometimes I just... sit there, staring at simple things. Like trying to decide whether to call the pharmacy, or... or just open the mail first. My mind just gets sort of... foggy. I usually end up doing neither.
When you are going through these low periods, have you noticed any significant changes in your sleep, such as difficulty falling asleep or wanting to sleep much more than usual?
No, not really. I just... I sleep about the same as I always do. It hasn't really changed.
Do you often feel a sense of hopelessness about the future?
I don't think so. I just... take things one day at a time, really. I don't think about the future much.
Do you often find yourself being overly critical of yourself or feeling like you are a burden to others?
No, I wouldn't say that. I just... I try to keep to myself mostly. I don't really think about it like that.
Do you often feel that you are generally ineffective or unproductive in your day-to-day life?
No, I... I get done what I need to get done around the house. It's just normal, everyday things. I don't really think about it being productive or not.
Do you often feel that you are not as good as other people?
No, I... I don't really compare myself to anyone. I just live my life. I don't worry about what other people are doing.
